title: Neighbourhood Change & Gentrification
goal: Contrast historical neighbourhood baselines with ongoing shifts in housing affordability and gentrification
grammar: imperfecto vs present perfect in urban feature reporting

items: I can contrast a neighbourhood's past baseline (*imperfecto*) with ongoing housing shifts (present perfect).
I can frame urban change with *mientras que*, *sin embargo* and *en la última década*.
I can use core vocabulary for urban planning, gentrification and neighbourhood fabric.
